messages:
sam: quick heads-up — packaging team pushed the private-vpc installer bundle to staging-artifact-store. need to lock down a 30m transport quarantine window and confirm rollback triggers before we hit canary.

jess: thanks. what's the proposed window? any constraints from ops?

sam: thinking 02:00-02:30 UTC tomorrow (low traffic), cosign already applied. KMS handoff scheduled at 01:45.

olivia: 02:00 UTC works for us. FYI security wants the cosign attestation uploaded to s3://redwood-signs/ephemeral/ before release. can we verify checksums?

mike: uploading the shas now. also tagging images with `private-vpc-v3.7.1-canary` — please don't reuse that tag.

sam: agree on pinning. deploy-bot, please start canary 02:00 and run 10 hosts for 20 minutes, then scale to 100 if no regressions. fallback to `private-vpc-v3.7.0` on any of the rollback triggers below.

deploy-bot: @sam acknowledged. canary plan created: 10 instances for 20m -> 100 instances. healthchecks: 5xx rate, start failures, install-timeouts. automated rollback triggers set to thresholds provided.

jess: list the explicit rollback thresholds here so support and sre know what to watch.

sam: rollback triggers: 
- >1% 5xx across canary hosts sustained for 5m
- >3% failed installs across canary batch
- installer preflight DB migration error (any)
- cosign verification mismatch on node after unpack
- manual abort from oncall or release lead

olivia: adding network-level trigger: if S3 reachability to artifact-store fails for >2m during rollout, deploy-bot abort.

mike: confirm artifact pinning details: images pushed to private-registry.redwood:443 and manifest pinned to `sha256:4a7b...c9f2`. recording in release notes.

sam: good. also adding an emergency quick-rollback command snippet for oncall: 
```
# quick rollback to previous pinned image
deploy-bot rollback --target private-vpc --image sha256:2f3e...9a01 --reason "canary-failure" --force 
```

jess: can infra-bot run a preflight smoke now (cosign + sha checks) and post the result? want to avoid surprises at 02:00.

infra-bot: preflight started. checks: cosign present, signatures valid, sha256 match, k8s manifests rendered. ETA 2m.

infra-bot: preflight complete — all checks PASS. cosign: OK, manifest-hash: sha256:4a7b...c9f2 recorded. uploaded attestation to s3://redwood-signs/ephemeral/4210009876.json

mike: pushing updated release-notes snippet to the release bucket and tagging the PR. also setting `canary-window: 30m` in the deploy config.

sam: last call for change-window objections? else we'll proceed with the 02:00 UTC window and coordinated oncall.

jess: no objections from product/compliance. I'll be oncall during the window.

olivia: noted, I'll monitor cosign and network during canary.

sam: perfect. post-canary checklist: 1) confirm no regressions, 2) promote tag to `private-vpc-v3.7.1` for Dedicated customers, 3) start packaging the airgap bundle for onprem delivery with the same pinned manifest.

deploy-bot: canary started at 4210010800 (scheduled). will post updates and trigger rollback if thresholds hit. :rocket:

mike: adding a note — for the airgap bundle, we need to include `cosign.sig` and the `attestation.json` in the transport payload. don't omit them.

sam: thanks — adding to packaging checklist. will post the final release notes after canary. :thumbsup:
